operation: one bounded task-5 target acquisition window
policy: snapshot-diff amendment: before/after protected-path inventory + exact manifest equivalence
sizing_rationale: two ~337s SHA-256 inventory traversals (task-5-traversal-measurement-outcome-2) plus read-only extraction, hashing and a one-shot bounded transfer, with fixed headroom; no retries.
writes_on_target: /tmp only: acquisition scratch (copied input tree, before/after manifests, diff, receipt, acquisition record, extracted payload)

transfers.evidence_bytes_bound_rationale: 512 MiB >= two measured ppic manifests (270867 entries) totaling 269293938 bytes plus receipts; the old 256 MiB bound was smaller than the measured pair
transfers.streaming_enforced_by: tools.target_safety.acquire_transport (fail-closed while streaming, not after whole read)

transport.stdin: deterministic source tar of the route + frozen input policy
transport.stdout: one bounded tar archive: before/after/diff/receipt/acquisition + rootfs
transport.durable_records: stderr + exit status retained locally per window

quiet_boundary: proportionate before/after process+cwd observations; status=unproven-activity admitted when activity prevents a serialized window; never a claim that a clean inventory proves absence of writers
